passive.name: Sunlight
passive.description: Damaging spells afflict enemies with Sunlight for 1.5 seconds. When allied Champions deal damage to those targets, they consume the Sunlight to deal additional magic damage.

spells.name: Shield of Daybreak
spells.description: Leona's next Attack Stuns for seconds and deals an additional magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamageTooltip was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Eclipse
spells.description: Leona raises her shield, reducing incoming damage by and gaining Armor and Magic Resist for seconds. Afterwards, her shield detonates, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies. If she hits at least one, she retains the Armor and Magic Resist bonuses for an additional seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamageTooltip was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Zenith Blade
spells.description: Leona thrusts with a sword of light, dealing magic damage. The last champion struck will be Rooted for seconds and Leona will dash to them.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamageTooltip was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Solar Flare
spells.description: Leona calls down a radiant beam of solar energy dealing magic damage and Slowing by % for seconds. Enemies in the center of the flare are Stunned instead of Slowed.
